description_en: Queries all users with whom a custom image has been shared. The results are displayed by page, with 10 entries per page by default
description_zh: 查询一份自定义镜像已经共享的所有用户。持返回结果支分页显示，每页的信息条目默认为10条

name: DescribeImageSharePermission
